correctness.rationale: For the explicit fifteen valuation weights of the Springer paper Example 1.3 (the submitted references incorrectly call it Example 1.2), compute all lower facets: 16 unimodular triangles filling 4Δ2. For each of 2^14 coefficient signs with s00 fixed positive, Viro patchwork in four reflected copies connects midpoints on opposite-sign edges, antipodally identifying boundary of Newton diamond. Independently reimplemented exact integer-midpoint union-find (not source code) across all 16,384 assignments: #components=1+A+B+C for every assignment. Exactly 2048 assignments realize each triple (A,B,C), giving 2048/6144/6144/2048 one-/two-/three-/four-component cases. Cueto-Markwig Table 1 necessary-and-sufficient lift conditions give count 4(1+A+B+C+AB+AC+BC)=4,8,16,28. In classical genus-three real quartic classification, two components with 8 real bitangents must be two nonnested ovals; thus excludes empty and nested-two-oval four-bitangent cases in this fixed chamber. Exhaustion proves this finite classification for specified triangulation; it does not extend to arbitrary valuations.
